name: Pricefy
summary: Competitor price monitoring and dynamic repricing for e-commerce — AI product matching, price-intelligence dashboards, feed channels and autopilot repricing.
best_for: e-commerce sellers monitoring competitor prices and repricing catalogs up to ~25,000 SKUs on rules or autopilot
skip_if: you need intraday or real-time repricing at marketplace speed, or your catalog is small enough that the 50-SKU free tier is all you will ever use
honest_knock: Credit where due: the free tier is real. But the paid ladder rises fast — Starter at $49 buys only 100 SKUs, and repricing itself waits for Pro at $99 — and price updates run at most twice a day even on Enterprise, so this is rules-based repricing, not marketplace-speed. The headline prices are monthly rates; the advertised savings require annual commitment.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again on 2026-09-28) A genuinely free tier: $0 for up to 50 SKUs, 5 competitors, daily price updates and AI automatch. Paid, with yearly billing saving 25%: Starter $49/mo ($37 annually), Pro $99/mo ($74), Business $189/mo ($142) and Enterprise $499/mo ($374). Starter covers 100 SKUs, Pro 2,000, Business 15,000 and Enterprise 25,000. Every paid plan adds unlimited competitors, twice-daily updates, email alerts and Excel/CSV reports; dynamic repricing starts on Pro, and autopilot repricing with MAP/MSRP monitoring on Business. Every plan, free included, carries AI product matching, competitor monitoring and daily price updates — what you buy going up is SKU volume and automation, not the core.

compare_with.name: Prisync
compare_with.why: Prisync is the category veteran with similar per-SKU tiers; Pricefy undercuts on entry price and ships a real free tier — both cap update frequency, so speed-critical repricers need marketplace-native tools
